mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking_status_transmission_info ( request_tracking_id, tracking_process_id, msg_status, last_observed_at, no_data_refs, checked_time, transmission_time, transmission_status, transmission_url, transmission_param, transmission_resp_code, transmission_resp_msg ) VALUES ( #{requestTrackingId}, #{trackingProcessId}, #{msgStatus}, #{lastObservedAt}, #{noDataRefs}, #{checkedTime}, NOW(3), #{transmissionStatus}, #{transmissionUrl}, #{transmissionParam}, #{transmissionRespCode}, #{transmissionRespMsg} )
mapper.select: SELECT st.status_transmission_id AS statusTransmissionId, st.request_tracking_id AS requestTrackingId, st.tracking_process_id AS trackingProcessId, tp.trckPrcIdtifier AS trckPrcIdtifier, tp.tracking_process_identifier AS trackingProcessIdentifier, tp.tracking_process_type AS trackingProcessType, st.msg_status AS msgStatus, st.last_observed_at AS lastObservedAt, st.no_data_refs AS noDataRefs, DATE_FORMAT(st.checked_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS checkedTime, DATE_FORMAT(st.transmission_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS transmissionTime, st.transmission_status AS transmissionStatus, st.transmission_url AS transmissionUrl, st.transmission_param AS transmissionParam, st.transmission_resp_code AS transmissionRespCode, st.transmission_resp_msg AS transmissionRespMsg FROM tracking_status_transmission_info st LEFT JOIN tracking_process_info tp ON st.tracking_process_id = tp.tracking_process_id WHERE st.request_tracking_id = #{requestTrackingId} ORDER BY st.status_transmission_id DESC
